plugins.name: onyx
plugins.description: Pull knowledge from your parcelLab Onyx instance into Claude — semantic search, cited RAG answers, and full-document retrieval. Run /onyx-setup after installing to connect your own account.

plugins.name: parcellab-brand-layout
plugins.description: Create branded transactional email layouts in your ParcelLab account from any brand website URL. Browses and previews with Claude Code's built-in browser (Browser pane), pushes via the ParcelLab MCP connector.

plugins.name: parcellab-create-order
plugins.description: Create a real order in your ParcelLab account via the production Order API. Fills in realistic dummy data when you only provide partial context (country, scenario, tracked/untracked).

plugins.name: parcellab-demo-request
plugins.description: Create a custom ParcelLab demo request from a prospect website URL. Researches the site, collects four representative products, verifies image URLs, asks for approval, then submits via the Custom Demo Creator API.

plugins.name: parcellab-order-lifecycle
plugins.description: Simulate a full ParcelLab post-purchase journey: source a real product, create an untracked order, then push a timed sequence of tracking checkpoints (warehouse -> carrier -> delivery) so ParcelLab fires the comms for each stage.

plugins.name: parcellab-bug-investigation
plugins.description: Investigate and document a ParcelLab product bug: inspect live config via parcellab-cli, reproduce interactively in Claude-in-Chrome with real screenshot/recording capture, isolate root cause against sibling portals/configs, and publish a shareable bug-report artifact (plus a standalone HTML file and PDF for people without Claude access) before any mitigation is applied. Any mitigation requires express, account-number-specific authorisation.
